name: Lucia Sol
source:
The protagonist, a girl who lives together with her uncle Horik.
She helps out at the cafe "Kokono Kokono".
Because of her calm atmosphere and kind personality, many customers come to the cafe just to talk with her.

When the strange event hit the peaceful bustling streets her hourglass started giving off a strong light.
